snippet.title: Your Next Cozy Multiplayer Indie Game: Cozy Crossroads (Early Look)
snippet.description:
🌸 Welcome to Cozy Crossroads! A cozy multiplayer game where you can fish, chop wood, mine ore, and explore a peaceful world with friends.
🏡 Join our community on Discord: https://discord.gg/yS2WehDZpS

In this Early Look trailer for Cozy Crossroads, discover your next cozy multiplayer indie game that merges the relaxing charm of titles like Stardew Valley and the friendly spirit of Animal Crossing. 

We invite you into a vibrant world brimming with fishing spots, scenic views, and cooperative activities, perfect for gamers looking for a relaxing getaway from all of life's stresses.

Cozy Crossroads is created with love by Term & Zera, a pair of married Game Devs chasing their dreams of creating games for the whole world to enjoy.

💬 What do you think of the trailer? Let us know in the comments!

🎥 Check out our full playlist of Cozy Crossroads Content:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLl1kYzfJzQ7eM00Nwcdq6wXzMugDTYxVh

📌 Follow us for updates:
Twitter: https://x.com/cozy_crossroads
Discord: https://discord.gg/yS2WehDZpS

🎶 Music Credits: Mellow Summer Folk - Alex Kizenkov

#cozygames #indiegame #multiplayer #animalcrossing #stardewvalley
